title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
summary: Connect all points using links whose costs are the horizontal plus vertical distance between the endpoints.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–1000 distinct two-dimensional integer points. Coordinates are in [−1000000, 1000000].

statement: Connect all points using links whose costs are the horizontal plus vertical distance between the endpoints. Choose links so all points are connected and the total cost is as small as possible. Return that cost.

examples.explanation: The horizontal link costs 3 and the vertical link costs 2.
A single point needs no links.
Three sides of length 2 connect the square.

constraints: 1–1000 distinct two-dimensional integer points. Coordinates are in [−1000000, 1000000].
hints: Conceptual: A cycle contains a link you can remove while preserving connectivity.
Directional: Grow one connected group by adding its cheapest link to a point outside the group.
Implementation: Store each outside point’s best distance to the group. When a point joins, update those distances using the new point.
complexityAnalysis: O(n²) time and O(n) auxiliary space for dense Prim without materializing all edges.
